CustomField.description: Provides a visual star-style welfare risk indicator derived from the animal's current welfare risk.
CustomField.formula: CASE( TEXT(Current_Welfare_Risk__c), "Critical", IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_red.gif", "Critical", 16, 16) & " ***** Critical", "High", IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_red.gif", "High", 16, 16) & " **** High", "Moderate", IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", "Moderate", 16, 16) & " *** Moderate", "Low", IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "Low", 16, 16) & " * Low", "Grey - Not rated" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Derived automatically from Current Welfare Risk for quick visual triage.
CustomField.label: Welfare Rating
